review_evidence: README states that the Lean subtree formally verifies the mathematical model underlying the forest integral-projection model, including convergence, non-negativity, and boundedness properties independent of the R implementation.

The twelve primary Lean files cover the formal kernel, growth, survival, ingrowth, competition, climate, quadrature, community dynamics, and asymptotic population-growth results; the README explicitly reports machine-checked theorems in these modules.
These files are the mathematical specification/proof layer of the project, so no lossless primary exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the complete Lean mathematical specification and proof layer for forestIPM.
